thread:
anya: quick call outcome summary needed. PMs want a 2-sprint "cost-first" pilot for two mobile customers. we need a trimmed scope decision by EOD.
sam: constraints to keep in mind: p95 latency budget, at least 20% token cost drop, and strong eval guardrails for payments.
tariq: field reports: intermittent cellular drops on target customers. they care more about perceived latency than raw throughput. also low-memory devices.
nina: ops history: last time we increased batching window we saw a few truncated outputs; support load spiked for 48h. must have clear rollback triggers.
lucy: support will need a short FAQ and an automated triage tag when regressions look quant-related. i'll prepare.
sam: trimmed-MVP idea: 1) adaptive micro-batching (default 30ms, cap 90ms), 2) server-side prefix caching hints for repeated quick flows, 3) conservative quant ladder: prefer 8-bit for contexts <512 tokens, no 4-bit in pilot. keep client changes out.
tariq: acceptance / launch gates suggestion: - cost/token reduction >=20% on pilot routes - p50 latency <= baseline+7% and p95 <= baseline+20% - eval-concordance >=0.97 on golden prompt sets - <=2 SE escalations/week.
nina: rollout plan: feature-flag -> canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 24-48h holds. eval-alerts will auto-notify #optimize-ops and auto-rollback on severity.
sam: eval-alert config prototype (lightweight):
```
name: mobile-cost-pilot
eval_sets: [payments_short, auth_ui]
metrics:
  concordance: 0.97
  p95_latency_factor: 1.2
actions:
  - notify: #optimize-ops
  - rollback: true
  - create_ticket: ops-triage
```
anya: ownership: sam -> rollout and dashboards, tariq -> eval harness (add quant fallback tests), lucy -> support playbook and customer comms, nina -> on-call triage runbook. i'll sync customers for golden prompts.
sam: if we need to shrink scope further: ship batching + eval-alerting first; add server-side caching in v1.1. quantization optional for v1 pilot.
tariq: agree. experiments with 6/4-bit can be internal-only behind separate flag. add regression prompt set to catch known 4-bit failures.
lucy: drafting customer-facing blurb about fallback to higher-precision when we detect quality drops. will share by EOD.
ops-bot: feature-flag branch merged to staging at 1750001200. CI green.
anya: recap and next sync: sam PR for rollout steps + dashboards, tariq adds fallback evals, lucy drafts support/email, i'll collect golden prompt sets. reconvene Friday morning to gate launch. :calendar:
